stance_basis: paraphrase states Plautz represented a group supporting Airport Spur construction
summary: Edgar G. Plautz appeared as a commenter representing a group of individuals who support construction of the Airport Spur, arguing it will relieve existing congestion and hazards on existing facilities in the area. The document notes no response was necessary to his supportive testimony.
